# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 104 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51-52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 104

**1** They said to Jesus: "Come, let us pray today and let us fast." Jesus said: "What sin have I committed, or wherein have I been found wanting? But when the bridegroom has come out of the bridal chamber, then they may fast and pray."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Wherein have I been found wanting" — the defeat as spiritual deficiency
- "Has come out" — the perfect tense marking the completed exit
- "May fast and pray" — permission granted at the appropriate time
